snippet.title: Cyberwar gameplay (PC Game, 1994)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Cyberwar, Dos PC game produced by Coconuts Japan Entertainment Co. in 1994 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/cyberwar/7508/
Watching the intro and trying a couple of levels of this science fiction action game.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
